label: GDP per capita, PPP
notes: GDP per capita based on purchasing power parity.

label: GDP growth
notes: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency.

label: Inflation
notes: Inflation measured by the consumer price index.

label: Poverty headcount ratio at $3.65 a day
notes: International poverty line for lower-middle-income countries; coverage is sparse because it depends on household surveys.

label: Gini index
notes: Coverage is sparse because it depends on household surveys.

label: Life expectancy at birth
notes: Average number of years a newborn would live if current mortality patterns stayed constant.

label: Under-5 mortality rate
notes: Probability of dying between birth and age 5 per 1,000 live births.

label: Secondary school enrollment
notes: Gross enrollment ratio can exceed 100 because of over-age or under-age students.

label: CO2 emissions per capita
unit: tons of CO2 equivalent per person
notes: Carbon dioxide emissions excluding land use, land-use change, and forestry per person.

label: Government effectiveness
notes: Perception-based composite indicator; compare changes cautiously.

label: Control of corruption
notes: Perception-based composite indicator; compare changes cautiously.
